gbm_population_evidence.quote: A Phase I Study of Human Placental Hematopoietic Stem Cell Derived Natural Killer Cells (CYNK-001) in Adults With Recurrent Glioblastoma Multiforme (GBM)
Histologically confirmed glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) and are at first or second relapse.

candidate_evidence.quote: This study will find the maximum safe dose (MSD) or maximum tolerated dose (MTD) of CYNK-001 which are NK cells derived from human placental CD34+ cells and culture-expanded.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) and are at first or second relapse.

role_evidence.quote: CYNK001-IV (other names: CYNK-001 dose level 1 for IV): Planned Starting dose dor IV 1.2x10\^9 cells/dose

agents.drug_class_hint: allogeneic placental CD34+-derived natural killer cell therapy (cell therapy), intravenous

role_evidence.quote: CYNK001-IT (other names: CYNK-001 dose level 2 for IT): Planned starting dose for IT 200 x10\^6 +/- 50 x10\^6 cells dose

agents.drug_class_hint: allogeneic placental CD34+-derived natural killer cell therapy (cell therapy), intratumoral via Ommaya catheter

role_evidence.quote: CYNK-001 cells will be given after lymphodepleting chemotherapy for the systemic cohort (IV) (intravenous). The intratumoral cohort (IT) will not be giving lymphodepletion.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent used here as lymphodepleting conditioning before NK cell infusion

coder_notes: NK cell therapy (CYNK-001) = excluded intervention type; IV and IT products listed separately as registered. Cyclophosphamide is not a registered intervention; it appears only in conditions/keywords and as 'lymphodepleting chemotherapy' for the IV cohort. Coded supportive (conditioning for cell therapy, no antitumour hypothesis); manual has no specific role for lymphodepletion - adjudicator may prefer another non-candidate role. 'Astrocytoma, Grade IV' and 'primary and secondary recurrent GBM' wording suggests historical classification.
